source_text: Traditional African religions often invoke ancestral spirits or initiation rituals without centralized texts, framing FGM as divinely sanctioned for fertility or clan purity, as documented in ethnographic studies of Kenyan and Nigerian groups where shamans cite oral traditions predating Abrahamic influences. [6]
